title: SRM Current Controller
text: Current control for switched reluctance machines, 6 inputs, 2 outputs; {Proportional gain} sets the controller proportional gain, K p, {Integral gain}, {Anti-windup gain} and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Proportional gain
params.values: Controller proportional gain, K p 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integral gain
params.values: Integral gain, K i 5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Anti-windup gain
params.values: Anti-windup gain, K aw 1 (default) | positive scalar
